narration_fil: Sa silungan, may batang kulang sa pagkain at mahaba ang pila sa tubig. May residenteng nangangailangan ng gamot; ang isa ay nababagabag.
narration_en: At a temporary shelter, a child may lack food, safe water is limited, a resident needs regular medicine, and another is distressed.

narration_fil: Tukuyin ang apat na larangan: medical/public health, nutrisyon, WASH, at mental health/psychosocial support (MHPSS). Iugnay ang bawat pangangailangan sa tamang staff. Ipaabot agad ang panganib at naputol na serbisyo. Sa nababagabag, suriin ang kaligtasan. Makinig nang may pahintulot at iugnay sa praktikal na tulong at kwalipikadong suporta.
narration_en: Identify and link four domains: medical/public health, nutrition, safe water/sanitation/hygiene (WASH), and mental health/psychosocial support (MHPSS). Alert assigned staff to urgent risk and interrupted services. For a distressed person, check safety, listen with consent, and link to practical help and qualified support.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang unang ligtas na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: What is the first safe step?

options.fil: Ipagpalagay na tama pa ang lumang impormasyon at agad itong ipasa sa lahat.
options.en: Assume the old information is still correct and immediately relay it to everyone.

options.fil: Iugnay ang apat na domain sa itinalagang staff; itala ang naputol na serbisyo.
options.en: Link all four domains to assigned staff; record interrupted services.

options.fil: Magpasiya mag-isa nang walang lokal na kumpirmasyon o opisyal na babala.
options.en: Decide alone without local confirmation or an official warning.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring luma o mali ang impormasyon. 2: Ikinokonekta nito ang pagpapasya sa beripikadong plano at saklaw. 3: Kailangan ang tamang awtoridad at lokal na konteksto.
check.feedback_en: 1: Information may be old or wrong. 2: This ties action to a verified plan and scope. 3: The correct authority and local context are needed.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

display_fil:
Suriin ang opisyal na plano.
Kumpirmahin ang lokal na contact.
display_en:
Check the official plan.
Confirm the local contact.
narration_fil: Ipinasa ng BHW ang tubig sa WASH team. Ang pagkain ay sa nutrition team; ang gamot ay sa clinician. Nakinig siya sa nababagabag nang hindi pinilit ang salaysay at nag-alok ng referral.
narration_en: The BHW routes water to WASH, food to nutrition and medicines to a clinician. They speak calmly with the distressed person without demanding a story and offer referral.

display_fil:
Huwag manghula.
Igalang ang tungkulin at privacy.
display_en:
Do not guess.
Respect role and privacy.
narration_fil: Hindi ito pahintulot na magreseta, magtakda ng ration, magdeklara ng ligtas na tubig o magbigay ng therapy. Sundin ang lokal na clinical at service protocol.
narration_en: Recognizing a domain does not authorize prescribing, ration-setting, declaring water safe or providing therapy. Follow local clinical and service protocols.

display_fil:
Ano ang susunod na hakbang?
Subukan bago tingnan ang paliwanag.
display_en:
What is the next step?
Try before viewing the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Alin ang ligtas na susunod na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: What is the safe next step?

options.fil: Tratuhin ang lahat bilang isang medical case at magbigay ng sariling therapy. Huwag nang tanungin ang awtoridad o ang taong apektado.
options.en: Treat every need as a single medical case and provide therapy independently. Do not ask the authority or the affected person.

options.fil: Walang kailangang itala o balikan kahit hindi pa natatanggap ng tamang team.
options.en: Nothing needs recording or follow-up even without team acknowledgement.

options.fil: Ipaabot sa lead, itala ang handover, at balikan.
options.en: Inform the lead, record handover, and follow up.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring makapinsala o maantala ang tulong. 2: Nawawala ang accountability at continuity. 3: Tinitiyak nito ang malinaw na pananagutan at susunod na aksiyon.
check.feedback_en: 1: This may harm or delay help. 2: Accountability and continuity are lost. 3: This establishes clear ownership and next action.

narration_fil: Balikan ang kuwento. Piliin ang angkop na susunod na hakbang.
narration_en: Return to the story. Choose an appropriate next step.

narration_fil: Sa Lunes, ipa-verify ang apat na service contact at alternatibo. Suriin ang access para sa bata, buntis, may kapansanan at may regular na gamot.
narration_en: On Monday, verify four service contacts and backups; check access for children, pregnant people, people with disabilities and those taking regular medicines.
